answer: Apprentices earn a non-transferable ivory credential by completing a supervised ridge of graded tasks, each countersigned by distinct mentors so a single operator cannot mint parallel identities. A trellis of stake-weighted attestations then links each credential to bonded peers, forcing sybils to recruit independent corroborators who risk their own deposits. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
